conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Morgan, badge ID 742195. Whom am I speaking with?
Uh, this is Anna. I got a message that there's some kind of issue with my taxes?

Yes, Anna, this is a final notification regarding your federal tax filings. According to IRS records, there's an unresolved amount from your 2020 return, $3,720, which you failed to declare correctly.
What? That can't be. I used TurboTax that year, it said I was all good.

Ma'am, this is a legal matter. The IRS has conducted a secondary audit, and it shows underreported income. If this isn't resolved today, an arrest warrant will be issued and passed to your county sheriff's office.
An arrest warrant?! This doesn't make any sense. I never got anything in the mail.
We sent three certified notices. You failed to respond. The IRS considers this willful tax evasion, which is a federal offense under Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code.
Oh my God, I don't want to go to jail. What do I have to do?

You have two options: contest the case in federal court or resolve it out-of-court today by making an immediate restitution payment. The legal route may result in seizure of property, wage garnishment, and up to five years imprisonment.
I can't risk that. I just want to fix this.
Good. In that case, we will process a temporary stay of the arrest warrant. To do that, I need to verify your identity. Can you confirm your full name and the last four digits of your SSN?
Yes. Anna Jacobs, 9984.
Thank you. Now, the restitution amount is $3,720, but we can accept a partial payment of $1,500 to freeze the legal action. Are you able to make that payment today?
Maybe... but I don't have $1,500 in my account.
Do you have a credit card? Or access to a digital payment method? The Treasury Department accepts government-certified vouchers in the form of retail gift cards.
Wait, gift cards? That doesn't sound like the IRS.

Let me make this very clear: due to the emergency legal nature of this case, gift card redemption is part of the IRS's expedited settlement pilot program. It's fully documented. You will receive a digital tax receipt after submission.
Okay, okay. I can get to a store in like 20 minutes.

Good. Go to a Walmart or CVS and purchase three Apple gift cards of $500 each. Do not discuss this with anyone, or the warrant will automatically proceed. Once you have the cards, call this number back and read me the code on the back.
Alright... I'm going now.
Stay on the line. I'll guide you through. This is your final chance to resolve the tax violation without legal consequences.
